title: Exactly Right Media and iHeartPodcasts Celebrate 300 Episodes and More Than 22 Million Downloads of “That’s Messed Up: An SVU Podcast” with Special Guest John Stamos
summary: iHeartMedia is a leading global media and entertainment company specializing in radio, digital, mobile, social, live events and on-demand entertainment.
body_markdown:
*Stamos reveals the Full House memorabilia he kept, talks about his true crime obsession and shares the dark role he wants to play next*


*Listeners can hear the 300th episode now*[HERE](https://www.iheart.com/podcast/1119-thats-messed-up-an-svu-po-74038894)


**WHAT:** Exactly Right Media (ERM) and iHeartPodcasts celebrate the milestone 300th episode of “


[That’s Messed Up: An SVU Podcast](https://www.iheart.com/podcast/1119-thats-messed-up-an-svu-po-74038894) ,” which has surpassed more than 22 million lifetime downloads. In the episode, hosts Liza Treyger and Kara Klenk revisit “Bang” (Season 12, Episode 22) with the episode’s guest star, John Stamos.


In the wide-ranging conversation, Treyger and Klenk get Stamos talking about everything from his memorable role on SVU to his decades-long history performing with the Beach Boys. Stamos also reveals the Full House memorabilia he’s held onto—including the iconic Tanner family couch.


Treyger and Klenk also dig into Stamos’ real-life fascination with true crime and his interest in taking on darker characters—sharing the role he’d like to tackle next: “I want to play a cult leader.” Stamos also tells the hosts that he has acquired the rights to a Dateline story for a project currently in development.


**WHO:** Hosted by comedians Liza Treyger and Kara Klenk, “That’s Messed Up: An SVU Podcast” breaks down episodes of NBC’s “Law & Order: SVU” each week, taking listeners inside the true crimes that inspired the series and featuring candid conversations about pop culture, entertainment, television and more. Past guests have included SVU cast members Kelli Giddish, Danny Pino, Dann Florek and BD Wong, helping make the podcast a destination for SVU and true crime fans.


“


[That’s Messed Up: An SVU Podcast](https://www.iheart.com/podcast/1119-thats-messed-up-an-svu-po-74038894) ” is part of the Exactly Right Media Podcast Network, with iHeartMedia serving as the exclusive sales, marketing and distribution partner for ERM’s full slate of premium podcasts.


**WHEN:** The 300th episode will be released September 1, 2026, with new episodes releasing weekly on Tuesdays.


**WHERE:** “That’s Messed Up: An SVU Podcast” is distributed by iHeartPodcasts and is available on the iHeartRadio App and everywhere podcasts are heard. Listen now


[HERE](https://www.iheart.com/podcast/1119-thats-messed-up-an-svu-po-74038894) .


**About Exactly Right Media**


The


[Exactly Right](https://www.exactlyrightmedia.com/) podcast network provides a platform for bold, creative voices to bring to life provocative, entertaining and relatable stories for audiences everywhere. Created by Karen Kilgariff and Georgia Hardstark, hosts of the hit podcast My Favorite Murder, the Exactly Right roster of podcasts covers a variety of topics and voices, serving the highly engaged listenership.
